title: Fats's idea of a stage wedding, and waking him for mystery outings
summary: Fats talked him into marrying during the show, and often roused him from bed to go along without saying where.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well anyhow, so you got married in Philadelphia during the show. How did you happen to get married during the show?
Well, we were working there. We were there during an engagement, you know. We got two weeks, and I had promised her, and she caught me.
(Laughter, clap, clap, clap.)
You know how those things -- you know how those things --
Did you promise her it would be on the stage of the theater during the show?
No, I didn't -- no, no.
How did that come up?
Well Fats, God bless him --
(Laughter.)
-- my pal, he say, I've got an idea. I said -- I'm always afraid of his ideas.
(Laughter.)

Let's do it in the theater, and it'll be very good, I say publicize it? No. I will give you this, and I will do that. No, I say, I let him out-talk me, so that was that. We got married in the theater.
Were you the hit of the show?
Uh-huh.
You were? (Laughs.) Did Fats do things like this to you, very often? You said you were --
Yeah, he would come get me, and wake me up out of bed --
What kind of --

-- and 'Come on, you sausage, get up out of that bed! Come on wake up.' I'd say sh! 'Naw, come on. What are you doing? What are you laying there? Come on with me?' I'd say where are we going? 'Never mind.' You know. (Smack) that was it.
And you would go with him wherever he suggested?
Yeah, well, because he was such a heck of a nice guy, and I -- in a way I couldn't lose. I wasn't married then.
Oh, this is before --
I wanted -- I wanted -- man, I wanted to sleep. I wanted to stay there and sleep all day. But going with him, making him happy, you know.
